theorems.name: Submission.frt_countablyRectifiable_of_graph_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (C : Set (Grassmannian N n × Set (Euclidean N))), C.Countable → (∀ c ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ c.2, ∀ z ∈ c.2, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖ ≤ ‖Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖) → M ⊆ ⋃ c ∈ C, c.2 → Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M
